title: Practicing at Samish, The Six Subtle Gates to the Sublime
speaker: Zoketsu Norman Fischer
summary: Zoketsu Norman Fischer invites listeners to explore the practice of listening to silence, which involves quieting the mind and tuning into the body's connection with the earth, allowing awareness to open up and revealing profound beauty and truth about oneself and the world. This practice can lead to a deeper understanding of one's nature and the ultimate reality of existence, beyond words and concepts. By embracing stillness and silence, we can access a state of stability, calmness, and questioning that reveals the true nature of existence.
